answers.q: Name the likely instrument family of the melody.

answers.q: How many beeps are there and at which pitches?

answers.q: Where do the high beeps come from: left, center or right?

answers.q: Where do the noise bursts come from?

answers.q: Where is the low thump located, and how many thumps are there?

answers.q: Is there a pitch sweep? Rising or falling, and when?

answers.q: When is the longest silence?

answers.q: Which beep comes from the right?

answers.q: Is there a very short click? Where?
